maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from first-time wholesale sales of new furniture and large goods on its B2B marketplace, plus logistics, not repairs.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private resellers and retailers buying furniture and bulky goods; final demand is commercial and consumer, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by expanding its marketplace, sellers, resellers and logistics network; acquisitions are occasional, not the main growth route.

mission_critical.reason: Resellers can source furniture from other wholesalers or suppliers; marketplace and logistics switching is moderately inconvenient but not critical.

notes: Switching cost is a judgement call: integrated logistics and Giga Index credit scoring add some stickiness.
